correctness.rationale: PASS. Bipartite parity classes each have 16 vertices; a guard covers only five opposite-parity vertices, forcing at least four even and four odd guards, so minimum eight. Independent complete enumeration of the 1820 four-sets within each parity found exactly 40 covering four-sets on each side, precisely affine two-plane cosets U_ij, hence 40²=1600 optima. Fresh enumeration of all 1600 sets, perfect matchings and the 3840 automorphisms gave five orbits 40,120,480,480,480 and paired total 1120, nonpaired 480; the 480 nonpaired orbit has induced 2P3⊔K2. Distinct affine planes sharing three points must coincide, so no legal same-parity optimum one-vertex swaps; cross-parity swaps violate 4+4 lower bound.
